messages:
sara_support: Customer (Acme) raised an escalation: intermittent schema validation failures for function/tool-calls. They see responses where the function output 'items' is null or missing. Example request id: req_a1b2c3. Need repro steps, logs, and debug bundle.

tom_engineer: Can you paste the raw response bodies (sanitized) and indicate whether this is Hosted/Dedicated + route + model + timestamps? Also include SDK version if available.

sara_support: Hosted. Route: POST /v1/generate (app route: acme/catalog-search). Model: redwood-chat-3.1. SDK: node-sdk 0.9.1. First hit ~2026-03-16T14:58:03Z (req_a1b2c3), next at 15:03:21Z (req_d4e5f6).

sara_support: Sanitized examples below.

sara_support: ```json
# resp for req_a1b2c3
{
  "id": "resp_x1",
  "object": "generation",
  "tool_calls": [
    {
      "name": "format_items",
      "arguments": null,
      "raw_output": "null",
      "schema_validation": {"ok": false, "errors": ["items: expected array, got null"]}
    }
  ]
}
```

sara_support: ```json
# resp for req_d4e5f6
{
  "id": "resp_x2",
  "object": "generation",
  "tool_calls": [
    {
      "name": "format_items",
      "arguments": "{\"items\":[]}",
      "raw_output": "{\"items\":[]}",
      "schema_validation": {"ok": true}
    }
  ]
}
```

eli_devex: Looks flaky. Could be model emitting literal null, or the postprocessor treating empty string as nil. Try reproducing via curl with explicit X-Request-ID so we can correlate logs.

eli_devex: Example curl (swap KEY):

eli_devex: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: reproduce-176347" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-chat-3.1",
    "route": "acme/catalog-search",
    "input": "Return top 3 product matches for query \"noise cancelling earbuds\"",
    "max_tokens": 200,
    "debug": true
  }'
```

maria_infra: If you reproduce, run with X-Debug=1 and then ask @support-bot to collect a debug bundle: `@support-bot collect-bundle reproduce-176347 --include=router,model-stdout,kv-cache`  that will generate a signed link. Capture the node host/container id that served the request.

sara_support: Ran the curl once with the customer's exact payload (sanitized). I got a failing output similar to their report:

sara_support: ```json
{
  "id": "resp_local_1",
  "tool_calls": [
    {"name": "format_items", "arguments": null, "raw_output": "null", "schema_validation": {"ok": false, "errors":["expected array for items"]}}
  ]
}
```

tom_engineer: Good repro. Paste router logs for X-Request-ID reproduce-176347 and model node logs. We need router recv, dispatch, model stdout, and validator trace.

sara_support: Router logs (sanitized):

sara_support: ```
[2026-03-16T15:20:12Z] router: recv req_id=reproduce-176347 route=acme/catalog-search host=node-3b
[2026-03-16T15:20:12Z] router: dispatch pool=redwood-chat-3.1/shard=1
[2026-03-16T15:20:13Z] model-node-3b: stdout: {"tool_call":{"name":"format_items","output":"null"}}
[2026-03-16T15:20:13Z] validator: schema fail: items -> expected array, got null
```

maria_infra: Collecting debug bundle now. Queued SSH to node worker-3b for `journalctl -u redwood-runtime` around the window. Will check for OOMs/GC spikes. If we have the bundle link I'll paste it here.

support-bot: debug bundle request accepted for reproduce-176347. collecting router,model-stdout,kv-cache. link will be posted when ready :gear:

eli_devex: I ran a quick 100x loop locally. Reproduced ~3 times where arguments==null. Saved one full raw response to a gist (sanitized): https://gist.github.com/eli/repro-null-case. It shows the model replying with a JSON containing `"output":"null"`.

tom_engineer: That indicates the model sometimes emits the literal token `null` when invoking the tool. Postprocessor currently does `json.Unmarshal` on the raw string; unmarshalling `null` yields nil -> arguments null. Fix pattern: treat literal null as empty structure or return clear validation error upstream. I'll open a small PR in postprocessor to defensively handle that case and add unit tests.

maria_infra: Debug bundle ready: https://debug.redwood.internal/bundles/reproduce-176347.tar.gz (expires in 72h). No OOMs; minor GC pauses at 15:19:58Z.

ops-billings: Customer reported extra retries and token usage. Hold credits until root cause confirmed and we have affected request ids. Please collect list of failed req ids and time windows.

tom_engineer: Plan: (1) merge postproc defensive handling (treat raw_output=="null" as empty object/array depending on schema) into a canary rollout, (2) add logging when parse yields nil, preserving raw model stdout, (3) run extended curl loop to verify reduction in failures.

sara_support: Uploaded bundle to ticket and informed ACME. They provided two additional request ids in their logs; added to ticket.

support-bot: canary deploy started: postproc-fix v1.1-canary on pool redwood-chat-3.1/shard=1.

maria_infra: Monitoring shows acme/catalog-search error rate dropped from 1.8% to 0.2% on the canary shard. No latency regression.

eli_devex: I'll paste the curl loop + gist into the support ticket as repro steps and mark the ones that failed. Also included the reproduce-176347 request id for traceability.

ops-billings: Prepare credit memo draft for the affected req ids. I'll wait for final confirmation before issuing.

tom_engineer: Merged PR and scheduled full rollout. Also added a unit test simulating model stdout with `"null"` and a case with empty string.

sara_support: Notified ACME of the fix, shared debug bundle link and the list of IDs we will credit. They acknowledged and asked to keep them posted if anything else shows up.

sara_support: Action items:
- tom_engineer: full rollout of postproc-fix + extra logging (EOD)
- maria_infra: extend model-stdout retention to 7 days for acme org, keep debug bundle (in progress)
- eli_devex: attach curl loop + gist to ticket (done)
- ops-billings: draft credit memo once final list confirmed

tom_engineer: Will close this thread after 24h of no repros. If anyone sees further flakiness, ping and we'll reopen.

sara_support: Thanks all — resolving here for now. :white_check_mark:
